BYPASSED_ID_SERVICE.why: mints an id under a prefix `cedar_ids.PREFIXES` owns, without calling `cedar_ids.allocate`. The service takes an exclusive file lock and re-reads the counter from disk so two agents cannot mint the same id; an f-string does neither.

OBJECT_ADDRESS.why: builtin id() is a memory address, stable only within one process.

POSITIONAL.why: assigned from a row's POSITION in an iteration. Stable only while the input is byte-identical and the iteration order is fixed.

PROCESS_HASH.why: builtin hash() on a string. PYTHONHASHSEED is randomised per process, so the id changes every build.

PROCESS_RANDOM.why: uuid4/urandom/unseeded random. A new value every call, by design.

RANK_DERIVED.why: assigned from a row's RANK among other rows. Shifts by one when any row above it is added, removed or reordered - and the rows above it live in a file another agent can write.

SET_ITERATION.why: iterates a set while minting ids. Set order is stable within a process and NOT across processes for str/bytes members.

earmark_id.cause: abs(hash(p.stem)) % 10**6 in the EXPLANATORY-statement branch only (the H and S branches are positional)
earmark_id.measured: not measured across builds - the E-branch rows are the only ones affected; H/S rows are positional, which is a different and lesser defect
earmark_id.why_unstable: same PYTHONHASHSEED defect as ferc_filing_id, found 2026-08-26 by 284_audit_nondeterministic_keys.py and NOT previously recorded anywhere

ferc_filing_id.measured: 4 of 2,534 documents shared between the 2026-08-12 and 2026-08-26 files kept their id
ferc_filing_id.why_unstable: Python randomises string hashing per process (PYTHONHASHSEED); the same document gets a new id in every build

individual_native_firm_contracts.csv.why: same one-hop exposure; the contract facts publish, the identifier that resolves to a person does not

individual_native_firm_register.csv.salt_note: NO SALT. A salt that is not persisted makes the key non-deterministic - the defect this module exists to kill. A salt that IS persisted is recoverable by anyone holding the file. The protection here is that the UEI column never ships, not that the digest is secret; say so plainly rather than implying more.
individual_native_firm_register.csv.why: SAM's public entity search resolves a UEI to a legal name and a street address. For a firm whose legal name IS a person's name, publishing the UEI publishes the person by one hop. cedar_domain already withholds awardee_uei and cage_code for exactly this reason; the primary key must obey the same rule or it reintroduces what the field policy removed.

verification_id.cause: INV-{rank:04d}, assigned in descending obligation order
verification_id.join_instead: SEE PRIVACY_SURROGATE - this table may not be keyed on its natural key either
verification_id.why_unstable: a concurrent agent rewrote prime_contracts.csv, every rank below the change shifted by one, and INV-0307 briefly carried another firm's ownership sentence
